scale: ORE 2015 DL development files ore_ont_14817 and ore_ont_9663, and GO 2026-07-26 with the Horn rules and with the EL rules alone

sides.base: 378127e2, the build of the last forge record of item 693
sides.tip: 27471426, the lane tip, which leaves out the range universals that the ranges of the final links cover
sides.keep: 27471426 with SPARKLES_HORN_RANGES=keep, which keeps every range universal, so that tip against keep isolates the rule on one binary

manifest.build: mbx build --release -p sparkles-owl --example el_classify on stanley, the laptop, with mbx 1.29.1 and the pinned toolchain, copied to atlas

settings.pinning: taskset, cpu 2 on one thread and cpus 2, 4, 6 and 8 on four
settings.scope: one process per run in a 12 GiB systemd scope without swap, with a 900 s timeout
settings.lock: the rounds ran under ~/lanes/.bench.lock and ~/lanes/.heavy.lock as the systemd user unit horn-ranges-693, alone on the host
settings.limits: ore_ont_14817 and ore_ont_9663 with --dl-attempt-work 1 and --repeat 3, so that the disjunctive attempt ends at once and the Horn rules answer; GO with --repeat 5 by default and with --el-only

method: timing.sh ran five rounds of the three sides in an order that rotates with the round and thread count, one process per side, file and thread count. analyze.py takes the median over the five processes of each process median classification, the ratio of each side to the base and the range of the five rounds ratios. tip and keep are one binary.

instructions_on_the_laptop.method: insn.sh: cpu_core instructions in user mode, pinned to a P-core, per classification as (count at --repeat 3 - count at --repeat 1) / 2, base fd47b7ae (the lane base) against the tip, on one thread with --dl-attempt-work 1

correctness_on_the_laptop.corpus_sweep: sweep.sh ran the tip with the rule and with SPARKLES_HORN_RANGES=keep on the 207 development and 187 final-set files of the ORE 2015 DL sample, none of them in the sealed held-out third, on one thread with --dl-attempt-work 1 in 8 GiB scopes. Each line gives the file, the side, the exit status, the taxonomy hash, and the tier, conclusions, conjunction contexts, universals left out and classification time
correctness_on_the_laptop.generated: gen.py 4000 cases with seed 693, cmp.sh with the rule on one and four threads and with keep on one, and hermit.sh with HermiT 1.4.5.519 on the cases that leave a universal out; each line gives the case, its status against HermiT and the subsumptions HermiT has that the tip lacks
